_comment: Spitfire, standing in for the low-wing aerobat. The whole aeroplane is one mesh named LOW_POLY - it names no parts at all, so the propeller cannot be spun and the orientation comes from the fin rule alone. Control surfaces are regions of the aeroplane: a span band as a fraction of the half span, a height band as a fraction of the half height, everything aft of `aft_of` along the length, and a hinge at that fraction of the LOCAL chord in the region. A downloaded airframe is one solid mesh and has no hinges of its own, so they are cut out of it.
